recent.text: Nuggets beat the Pacers 114-102 in Mexico City. Jokic led all with 19-13-8. First half was costly. Pacers trimmed the 27-point deficit to 7 with 7:26 to go, but Nuggets held on. Siakam scored 23, Nance Jr. with 15pts off the bench. Next: Mon. at DAL

recent.text: Jalen Slawson in, replacing Braden Smith. So now all 13 players have played. Giving the altitude, I figured everyone would get minutes. Quinn Buckner shares that guard T.J. McConnell, is his first game due to a hamstring strain, will not play in the second half.
recent.author: Scott Agness

recent.text: Pacers shot 33%, trail the Nuggets 64-41 at the half in Mexico City. Almost half their shots are 3s, and they’ve made just five. Siakam has 8pts, Zubac with 6/7 before foul trouble. Nuggets with only one TO. I’d expect a much better second half, though the altitude is very real
